title: Lightly Roasted Turkish Vegetables Kunefe
description: A kosher-friendly Turkish dish featuring roasted vegetables in a flaky kunefe form, wrapped in a lotus leaf vessel, perfect for a dinner meal. It has a nutty flavor and a monsoon twist.
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the eggplant, zucchini, red bell pepper, and onion with olive oil, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the vegetables in a single layer on a large baking sheet and roast for 30 minutes.
While the vegetables are roasting, prepare the kunefe pastry according to the package instructions.
Once the vegetables are done, let them cool for a few minutes.
To assemble the kunefe, place a few pieces of the roasted vegetables in the center of a piece of kunefe pastry, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Brush the edges of the pastry with a little water and fold the pastry over the vegetables to form a triangle, pressing the edges to seal.
Wrap each kunefe in a lotus leaf and place on a baking sheet.
Bake the kunefe for 15 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
